tei:div.tei:p: na mo gu ru we badzra ā tsarya tsa ra ṇa na mo na ma/ rtsa rgyud kyi bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs pa/ bla ma'i yon tan dran pa'i gsol 'debs ces bya ba/ bla ma dang dbyer med pa'i bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ / lha dang bcas pa'i 'byung po kun gyis rab tu gus pas btud nas gang gi zhabs sen spyi bos bsten/ /ye shes snang bas khams gsum thams cad dus rnams kun tu phyogs kyi 'khor lo gsal bar mdzad pa'i mgon/ /gnyis bral ris med mi 'gyur bde bas thugs rgyud gtams shing brtan g.yo srid zhi kun gyi rang bzhin mkhyen/ /rdo rje slob dpon stobs bcu mnga' ba yon tan rgya mtsho rigs kyi bdag por gus pas phyag 'tshal byin gyis rlobs/ /rdo rje rnam gsum dbyer med bde chen sku/ /kun tu chad med legs sbyar gzhom med gsung*/ /g.yo med lhun 'grub zung 'jug rdo rje'i thugs/ /rgyal dbang rdo rje 'chang la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal ba kun gyi zag med bde bskyed ma/ /spros bral mkha' la ye shes 'od stong shar/ /mtshan dpes rab spras dpag yas dkyil 'khor can/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la= rgyal ba sras bcas kun gyi sgra 'dzin dngos/ /rgyud dang mdo sde mtha' dag sdud pa'o/ /sa bcu'i dbang phyug rje btsun gsang ba'i bdag/phyag na rdo rje'i 'dzin la= 'dod pa'i lha dang grub pas rjes bzung bas/ /snying po'i don gzigs gdod ma'i mgon por gyur/ /grub brnyes kun gyi gtso bo zla med pa/ /sa ra ha pa'i zhabs la= spros bral rig pa'i rdo rjes mtha' gnyis bcom/ /rab dga' legs grub bde ba can du gshegs/ /dbang phyug brgyad kyi yon tan mchog brnyes pa/ /'phags pa klu sgrub zhabs la= de yis rjes bzung blo gros rin chen gyis/ /lung bstan rngon pa'i spyod pas 'gro ba 'dul/ /skye 'jig bral bas khyab bdag go 'phang brnyes/ /ri khrod dbang phyug zhabs la=

mkha' 'gros dngos su byin rlabs dka' ba spyad/ /spros med spyod pas mchog gi dngos grub thob/ /rig 'dzin kun gyi gtso bo lū yi pa/ /kun tu dge ba'i zhabs la= 'khor ba'i gnas tshul mkhyen nas rgyal srid spangs/ /a wa dhu tā'i spyod pas don mchog grub/ khri dang drug stong 'khor bcas mkha' la gshegs/ /dā ri ka pa'i zhabs la= gnas lnga rig pa'i mthar thug rgol ba 'joms/ /rim lnga'i lam las mgon khyod mngon byang chub/ /ngo mtshar cho 'phrul bstan pas 'gro kun tu/ /rdo rje dril bu pa la= ind+ra bhu ti lakṣiṃ la sogs pas/ /rjes su bzung nas tshe gcig grub pa brnyes/ /brtul zhugs spyod pa'i rol pa mtha' yas ston/ /katstsha li pa'i zhabs la= nges med spyod pas zung 'jug chen po brnyes/ /dpag yas grub pa'i dbang pos khyod zhabs bsten/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma yis tshogs kyis mgon/ /dza lan dā ra'i zhabs= ting 'dzin brtan pas gzung 'dzin spros pa bcad/ /spros bcas spyod pas bdud dang mu stegs btul/ /rgyal ba'i lung bstan bar dor rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /nag po spyod pa'i zhabs la= rgyal srid mchil ma'i thal ba bzhin bor nas/ /rim gnyis bsgoms pas mchog gi dngos grub thob/ /mi srun gdug pa'i mkha' 'gro ma yang btul/ /grub chen gu hya pa la= de yis zhabs bsten rgyud sde bzhi la mkhas/ /rim bzhin mthar phyin spyod pa gsum la slob/ /sdig spyod rgyal po 'dul mdzad rnam rgyal zhabs/ /bar ma'i slob dpon mchog la= gnyis snang sprin tshogs 'od gsal nam mkhar thim/ /rnam dag sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /mtha' gnyis kun spang rig ngan tshul 'dzin pa/ /rje btsun tilli pa la= smra ba'i dbang phyug rig pa'i gnas kun mkhyen/ /bla ma dges phyir dka' ba dpag med spyad/ /las 'phro sad pas lhan skyes ye shes brnyes/ /na ro ta pa'i zhabs la= srog rlung dbu mar thim zhing rdzu 'phrul dang*/

/lta stangs thogs med grub pas gzhan don mdzod/ /gsang sngags 'dzin pa'i gtso bor kun gyis bkur/ /pha na thing gu pa la= he ru ka dpal mchog gis rjes su gzung*/ /mkhas pa'i phul phyin bde mchog smra ba yis/ /phyogs kun khyab mdzad jo bo su mā ti/ /bha ranta pa'i zhabs la= bla ma gus par bsten pas gdams ngag thob/ /brtson par bsgrub pas nus mthu mngon du gyur/ /lhag bsam rin chen mchog ldan shes rab brtsegs/ /klog skya lo tsā'i zhabs la= bsod nams mthu yis bla ma dam pa mjal/ /mos gus dbang gis chos kun ji bzhin mkhyen/ /skad gnyis smra ba mal gyo lo tsā ba/ /blo gros grags pa'i zhabs la= mkhyen rab 'gran zla bral ba'i chos kyi rje/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi dngos su byin gyis rlobs/ /bsam yas ting 'dzin brnyes pa'i sa skya ba/ /kun dga' snying po'i zhabs la= sngon bsags bsod nams ye shes rgya che bas/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi rtse mor son/ /bde ba can gyi zhing du gshegs pa yi/ /bsod nams rtse mo'i zhabs la= phyogs 'dir sngags par grags pa kun gyi mchog /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan legs par 'dzin/ /mngon shes mthu stobs zad pa mi mnga' ba'i/ /rje btsun chen po'i zhabs la= gzhon nu'i dus nas 'jam dpal gnyis par grags/ /lha dang bla mas byin rlabs lung bstan thob/ /rig pa'i gnas lnga mkhyen pa'i paṇḍi ta/ /kun dga' rgyal mtshan zhabs la= gsung rab thams cad gzigs pa tsam gyis mkhyen/ /smon lam mthu chen rgyal ba'i sras po ni/ /'gro la snying nas brtse bas gzhan don mdzad/ /chos rgyal 'phags pa'i zhabs la= gzhung lugs dpag med mkhyen pa'i rin po che/ /'gro kun phan bde mdzad pa'i thugs rje can/ /bstan pa rin chen sgron me phyogs bcur sbar/ /mang mkhar lo tsā'i zhabs la= skyes bu dam pa du ma'i zhabs bsten pas/ /dbang lung man ngag thams cad thugs su chud/ /dam chos gsal mdzad bshes gnyen dam pa ste/

/dpal ldan seng ge'i zhabs la= shes bya kun la mi mkhyen gang yang med/ /gangs can bstan 'dzin dus gsum byung rnams kyis/ /rab mchog gtso bo skal bzang sems dpa' mchog /bu ston chos rjes zhabs la= skye rgu'i gtsug rgyan bsam pa ye shes che/ /ma lus chos rnams thams cad mkhyen par chud/ /bslab gsum dri med ye shes mu mtha' yas/ /bsod nams rgyal mtshan zhabs la= rnam thar gsum la nyes skyon thams cad spangs/ /dad dang brtson 'grus shes rab thos pa sogs/ /gang gi thugs la 'gran pa bzhin du gnas/ /byang chub seng ge'i zhabs la= rigs rus cho 'brang skyon med rigs su 'khrungs/ /thos pa rgya mtsho'i pha rol son nas kyang*/ /brtse ba'i phyag gis 'gro rnams skyong mdzad pa/ /ye shes rgyal mtshan zhabs la= rdo rje theg pa'i chos kun gsan zhing mkhyen/ /lhag pa'i tshul khrims gsang gsum nyes kun bral/ /byin rlabs stobs kyis rgya chen 'phrin las can/ /kun dga' bzang po'i zhabs la= rtsod dus kun mkhyen rin chen grub kyi gsung*/ /dri med chos la thos bsam rgyud sbyangs shing*/ /rdo rje slob dpon gnas thob dus 'khor ba/ /rin chen bkra shis zhabs la= bden gnyis rnam par dbye ba 'gran zla bral/ /so so yang dag rig pa bzhi rnams kyis/ /'gro phan bsam gyi mi khyab spyod yul can/ /shākya mchog ldan zhabs la= thogs med dus nas tshogs gnyis bsags pa'i mthus/ /thugs rje'i dri bsung phyogs bcu ma lus khyab/ /nga rgyal mi mnga' mkhyen pa'i gter chen po/ /brag dkar sems dpa'i zhabs la= rang byung lhan skyes 'od gsal mngon du gyur/ /gnas lugs mkhyen pas snang grags sgyu mar gzigs/ /rlabs chen spyod pas rang gzhan phan bde bsgrubs/ /bkra shis rnam rgyal zhabs la= /bla ma lhag pa'i lha yis byin gyis rlabs/ /brtul bzhugs dbang phyug ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i mchog /ye shes thugs rjes zol med mnga' ba yis/

/kun dga' grol mchog zhabs la= gang snang thams cad bde chen rol par gzigs/ /mtha' bral rtogs pas sgrib gnyis rang sar grol/ /rgyal ba rgyal sras thams cad 'dus pa'i dngos/ /lha dbang grags pa'i zhabs= yang na/ bgrang yas mdo rgyud kun la mkhyen pa rgyas/ /lhan skyes dga' ba'i rol pa dam chos kyi/ /rgyal mtshan sgreng mdzad rje btsun rdo rje 'chang*/ /kun dga' rgyal mtshan zhabs la= phyin chad brgyud pa'i bla ma 'dir 'jug/'og ma rnams phyin chad kyang rtsa ba'i bla ma'i gsol 'debs su bya'o/ / rigs kun bdag po ma lus 'khor lo'i mgon/ /gsang gsum zung 'jug bde chen rdo rje'i dngos/ /skyabs gnas thams cad gcig tu 'dus pa'i rje/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhabs la= dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsum dngos/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong chos kyi phung po'i mdzod/ /rig grol gnyis ldan 'dus pa kun gyi rje/ /skyabs gnas kun 'dus khyed la= srid dang zhi ba'i phun sum tshogs pa kun/ /mgon po khyed kyi thugs rje'i stobs las byung*/ /mtho ris thar pa'i lam ston mkhyen brtse'i gter/ /chos rje bla ma'i zhabs la= sangs rgyas byang sems rang rgyal nyan thos dang*/ /lha dang rab byung khyim pa mu stegs byed/ /brtan g.yo'i dngos po kun gyi tshul bzung nas/ /gang 'dul 'gro don mdzad la= 'dus byas thams cad glog ltar mi rtag cing*/ /srid pa mtha' dag sdug bsngal gsum rang bzhin/ /dal 'byor shin tu rnyed dka' bstan pa yis/ /dang por 'dren mdzad khyod la= bde sdug kun gyi rgyur gyur dge sdig gi /blang dor 'khrul pa med par ston pa po/ /nges par 'byung ba'i tshul khrims lam mkhan gyis/ /thar par 'khrid mkhas khyod la= rin chen byang chub sems kyi nor sbyin nas/ /theg mchog rab tu yangs pa'i grong khyer du/ /stong nyid snying rje'i dga' ston stsol mdzad pa/ /rgyal ba'i lam ston khyod la= /dri med dbang skur rnams kyis byin rlabs shing*/

/bskyed pa'i rim pas skye 'chi bar do yi/ /bag chags sbyong zhing tha mal snang zhen zlog /smin byed lam ston chos rjer= /a wa dhū tīr gnad du bsnun pa las/ /rlung dang khams kyi bgrod pa kun thim pas/ /gtum mo rnam gsum 'bar bas zhu bde thob/ /bde stong ston mdzad khyod la= /bde ba'i rang bzhin mtha' bzhi spros dang bral/ /sems nyid bde ba'i ngo bor rnam gnas pa/ /ris med ngo bor snang gsum rang bzhin thim/ /bde chen lam bzang gsal la= thog mtha' med pa'i sems nyid bde ba'i dngos/ /zhu bde'i rkyen gyis dri ma sbyangs pa las/ /zung 'jug dkyil 'khor yan lag bdun ldan pa/ /rdzogs rim mthar thug ston la= gdod nas mtha' bral bde chen mtshan dpes spras/ /thugs rje chen pos 'khor ba ma stong par/ /'gro la phan bde'i mthar thug 'bras rab stsol/ /sku gsum mngon gyur khyod la gsol ba 'debs/ /de ltar rtse gcig gsol ba btab pa yis/ /bdag dang mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad kyis/ /tshe 'dir bla med byang chub thob pa dang*/ /'phrin las lhun grub rgyun mi 'chad par shog/ // 'di la gzhi byas la gang mos kyi sgo nas brgyud pa gzhan yang 'dor len shes par bya'o/ /zhes pa'ang tā ra nā thas rang lo nyer gsum snron gyi tshes lnga la bsam gtan sdings su sbyar ba'o/ /maṅga laṃ/ /zhus dag mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i brgyud 'debs bzhugs/ -PAGE 36--PAGE 35--PAGE 30-
